title: Spellglass pack index, format packindex/1
description: The list of packs that ship with the app (public/packs/index.json): id, kind, version, path and SHA-256 of each pack file (blueprint Section 9.3, Section 12). Paths are relative to the index file and may not leave its folder. 'npm run packs:index' rewrites the hashes. The loader checks each entry on its own, so one bad entry fails only that pack.

path.description: Relative path of the pack file: folder and file names of letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, ending in .json, with no '.' or '..' segments.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of the file's bytes.
